title: Create the initial app
description:
This project is a rewrite of an old system kept here for reference (DO NOT MODIFY) under `old-system-reference` . There was a previous Telegram bot created that can be referenced under `old-system-reference/bot` .
A new design was created that is shown as a typescript class under `mock-interface.tsx` with the matching css under `mock-interface.css` .

We want to use TypeScript for the bot and the library:
'https://github.com/yagop/node-telegram-bot-api' (used by calling `npm i node-telegram-bot-api` ).
